hacker_news.title: Show HN: Base 402 – Clean web scraper monetized via HTTP 402 on Base L2
hacker_news.text:
Hi HN,

We built an open-source, autonomous web-to-Markdown scraper designed for LLM context windows and autonomous AI agents, monetized entirely via HTTP 402 Payment Required on Base L2.

Why HTTP 402 on Base?
Traditional scrapers require credit cards, monthly subscriptions, and KYC accounts—things autonomous agents and scripts cannot easily manage. With sub-cent transaction fees on Base L2, micro-payments are finally practical.

Key Architecture:
- REST API powered by Hono + Viem running on Edge runtimes.
- Deterministic payment verification: parses ERC-20 Transfer logs on the native USDC contract.
- Anti-replay protection with in-memory lock + atomic file persistence.
- Multi-RPC fallback pool with automatic retry to prevent RPC rate-limits.
- SSRF mitigation blocking RFC 1918, loopbacks, and cloud metadata (169.254.169.254).
- Hybrid payment model: direct 0.05 USDC per call, 3 free evaluation queries daily per IP, or $1/$5/$10 bulk deposit tanks issuing instant API keys (latencies < 5ms).

Interactive Playground: https://base-http402-extractor-api.alluring-cheque.workers.dev/playground
GitHub: https://github.com/psicossz29-netizen/base-http402-extractor-api

Feedback and thoughts on machine-to-machine payment protocols welcome!

reddit.title: Autonomous HTTP 402 Micro-API on Base L2: AI-native web scraper monetized with USDC
reddit.body:
Hey r/BaseChain,

I wanted to share a project exploring machine-to-machine (B2A) micro-economies on Base.

### The Problem:
AI agents and autonomous bots need clean web data for context, but traditional APIs require credit cards, email verification, and monthly plans. AI agents can hold cryptographic wallets, but they can't pass KYC.

### The Solution:
An autonomous web-to-Markdown extractor monetized via HTTP 402:
1. Client POSTs a URL to `/api/v1/extract`.
2. Server responds with `HTTP 402 Payment Required` containing the exact recipient address (`0x2231b680679FC790B5E676b0d566EF2EE4612414`) and token parameters ($0.05 USDC on Base).
3. Client sends the transfer and includes `X-Payment-Tx-Hash` in the retry.
4. Server verifies the receipt on-chain using Viem, enforces anti-replay guards, and streams back token-optimized Markdown.

To make it practical for high-frequency bots, we also added bulk deposit tanks ($1, $5, $10 USDC) that issue instant API keys, as well as 3 free daily queries per IP for evaluation.

Live playground: https://base-http402-extractor-api.alluring-cheque.workers.dev/playground
Open-source codebase: https://github.com/psicossz29-netizen/base-http402-extractor-api
